questions.stem: What does the respiratory quotient (RQ) measure?

options.text: The total amount of energy released during respiration
The ratio of carbon dioxide produced to oxygen consumed
The speed at which glucose is broken down
The number of ATP molecules produced

questions.explanation: The RQ is calculated as CO2 produced divided by O2 consumed. It indicates which type of substrate is being respired, as different substrates have different RQ values.
